newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK money steady to easier in featureless trade.
newsitem.headline: HK money steady to easier in featureless trade.

text.p: Interbank rates were steady to easier in very quiet trading after the Christmas holiday, dealers said on Friday.
"Short-date money eased while (longer) term rate was little changed in thin trading," a local bank dealer said.
The overnight rate fell to 4-1/2 3/8 percent from 4-13/16 3/4 on Tuesday but three-month money was steady at 5-9/16 7/16.

Dealers said participants were either on holiday or unwilling to take major positions ahead of the year-end. "There is no clear direction in the market and traders would rather wait until next year to take a fresh start," one said.
Government paper was even quieter with very few transactions noted in the morning, dealers said.
One-month yields eased to 4.28 percent from 4.31.
Three-year notes yielded 6.09 percent versus 6.10, the seven-year yield fell to 7.07 percent from 7.08 and the longest 10-year note yielded 7.32 percent versus 7.34.
